label: France Travail
terms_note: French PES (ex-Pôle emploi) with an open Offres d'emploi API on francetravail.io (OAuth client) — no client yet.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Identifiant client of a francetravail.io application subscribed to the 'Offres d'emploi' API (create it at https://francetravail.io/inscription, then add the API to the application).

fields.help: Clé secrète of the same francetravail.io application.

adapter.rate_note: The API's technical sheet on francetravail.io sets nombreAppelMax 100; data.gouv.fr (published by France Travail) lists '10 appels / seconde'. Kept at 5 per second.

search.note: GET /v2/offres/search ('Rechercher par critères'). motsCles is the keyword filter (each keyword at least 2 characters, several separated by commas). The place filters take INSEE codes (commune, departement, region), so location/country are not sent. Paging is the `range` parameter 'p-d' (first-last index, at most 150 per call); the runtime cannot compute the end index, so `range` is not sent and the platform's default window (the first 150 offers) is returned — `page` and `limit` are ignored. The total is only in the Content-Range header, so total is null. HTTP 206 (partial list) is a success; an empty search answers 204 (no postings). Salary is a label (salaire.libelle, in raw), not numbers.

get_posting.note: GET /v2/offres/{offerId} ('Consulter une offre', offerId is the 7-character offer id, e.g. 048KLTP). origineOffre.urlOrigine is the offer's page on francetravail.fr; e-mail contacts are masked by the platform (apply through that page). salaire.libelle, typeContrat and the rest stay in raw.

not_offered.me: No account endpoint: the application authenticates with the client credentials grant ('Cinématique OAuth: client credentials grant', https://francetravail.io/produits-partages/documentation/utilisation-api-france-travail/generer-access-token) and the API only documents search, offer details and référentiels.
not_offered.apply: No application endpoint: the offer detail says 'Pour postuler, utiliser le lien suivant: https://candidat.pole-emploi.fr/offres/recherche/detail/…' — candidates apply on the France Travail site.
